title: The Christmas photo in a window
logline: A family Christmas photo the shop framed in 2004, in a front window on main street in November, faded to blue, the family's faces gone pale. The frame's the only sharp thing. The page from the sidewalk.

panels.composition: A framed family Christmas photo standing in a house's front window seen from the sidewalk, the photo faded to blue with the faces pale, the frame crisp, November drizzle on the glass.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a framed family photo standing in a house's front window seen from a sidewalk, the photo faded blue with pale faces and the frame still crisp, November drizzle on the glass, no words
